title: Rating Worksheet: Full-Term Premium of a Named Non-Owner Policy Term Realigned for a DUI Requirement
content:
**Which terms are re-rated.** A Named Non-Owner Policy term is re-rated when an FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured is recorded with the status requested, filed or rejected, the term's package does not accept a DUI or DWI conviction within 60 months, and the named insured's violation points do not exceed 12. A term that does not meet all three keeps its full-term premium.

**Re-rated full-term premium.** The base, multiplied by the state factor, by the points class factor and by the term's months over six, rounded half up to the cent on the final figure only. The base is the six-month base rate of Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 for the whole term.

**Base rates** (the company's six-month base rate of each package):

| Package | Six-month base rate (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | 520.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM | 610.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50 | 760.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | 880.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 | 950.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100 | 1180.00 |

**State factors** (residence state):

| Residence state | FL | VA | TX | GA | AZ | OH |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| State factor | 1.00 | 0.94 | 1.08 | 1.05 | 0.97 | 0.88 |

**Points class factors:**

| Named insured's violation points on the term | 0 to 2 | 3 to 5 | 6 to 9 | 10 or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Points class factor | 1.00 | 1.12 | 1.28 | 1.50 |

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** A six-month term, residence state OH, 4 violation points: 950.00 multiplied by 0.88, by 1.12 and by six over six gives 936.32. On a twelve-month term with the same inputs the months over six are two, so the figure doubles before rounding.

| Points | Points class factor |
|---|---|
| 2 | 1.00 |
| 3 | 1.12 |
| 9 | 1.28 |
| 10 | 1.50 |
